taxonomy_note: Initial root-cause lens; reassess final mapping.

controls.boundary: Path traversal and unsafe file access — authoritative consumer
controls.source_trace: Trace caller path/identifier through decoding, joins, normalization, filesystem resolution and file open. Record the intended root, OS semantics and who can alter parent directories/links.
controls.controlled_verification: Use a temporary owned tree with one allowed file and one denied marker outside the intended subdirectory. Exercise the real path construction/open path and compare the opened object, not just a normalized string. If links are relevant, inspect their ownership/creation authority separately.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A traversal-looking string rejected before open is not file access. A lexical prefix match can disagree with filesystem containment, but an unreachable file path in dead code is not an exposed read.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Enforce the intended object boundary with supported canonical/descriptor APIs and appropriate link policy. Retest normal nested files, the original escape and denied marker without reading system files.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
